title: Location Visit Layer Preflight
baseCheckpoint: 1f6773e Add AgentTown direct map command preview

filesReviewed.evidence: HQ16D is scoped as a report-first sidecar that defines selected known/discovered sector -> visit layer -> receipt/event context -> return to map, with hidden sectors sealed.
Prior location-scene architecture recommends Overview Map -> selectable visible sector -> authored location scene -> event/receipt view -> return, with server-owned or server-linked descriptors.
Proof records known/discovered-only sector gate, read-only location scene descriptors, visual-only props, and disabled future mutation gates.
Direct map command previews validate against the current server-owned read model and keep renderer targets preview-only/read-only.
Proof records command target rings as visualOnly/readOnly/previewOnly and confirms all command confirmation routes stay existing guarded handlers.
Event Packet and objective markers are already visible, selectable, inspectable, read-only, visual-only, and zero-action map markers.
Scout movement is bounded to adjacent discovered/known cells and creates a receipt without revealing fog or creating routes/resources/etc.

buildExpeditionMapReadModel exposes discovered/known cell truth from server facts, creates hinted and locked_unknown placeholders, emits readOnly eventPackets, and applies fog-only terrain assets to hidden cells.
Existing Expedition Map route is GET/read-model, with Scout Sector and Move Unit as the bounded POST routes; no location visit route exists or is needed for this preflight.
Selected-sector UI suppresses hidden details for hinted/locked cells, resolves event packets by cell/receipt, and renders selected-sector/event packet/party surfaces as read-only.
HTTP tests prove Expedition Map read-only behavior, public terrain slots only for known/discovered cells, fog-only hidden cells, Scout Sector event packets, and hidden move target blocking.
Browser proof fixture includes visible known/discovered cells, hidden/hinted cells, event packet markers, objective markers, command targets, and hidden-truth renderer assertions.

firstSafeVisitableSectorType.name: known_scouted_sector_with_event_packet
firstSafeVisitableSectorType.whyFirst: It is already receipt/event anchored by Scout Sector and avoids turning generic resource-hinted site-plan cells into resource-like places.

recommendedFlow: show Visit affordance only when packet gate passes
inspect Scout Sector event packet and receipt context
return to map with same selected cell/event marker context

notes: The first slice can be implemented without server changes if it uses only existing expeditionMap cells, eventPackets, receipts, public terrain slots, and party snapshots.
A future reusable LocationSceneDescriptor/locationSceneRef should be server read-model-backed before arbitrary known/discovered cells become visitable.
